guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 以水流荷載、活體建立與河岸監測共同設計護岸。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Designing bank protection through hydraulic loads, plant establishment and monitoring. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: NRCS 生物工程補編出版於 2007 年，屬方法文獻年代
雷赫河復育計畫於 1998 年啟動，並非本課假設護岸開工日
教學假設：河岸剪力的尺度；rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa
教學假設：植生莖叢的阻力；rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N
教學假設：根系補強的有效面積；Tr=1600 N; As=0.2 m2; dc=Tr/As/1000=8 kPa
教學假設：木構護岸的浮力；rhow=1000 kg/m3; rhol=600 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=0.8 m3; Fu=(rhow-rhol)*g*V=3139.2 N
factsEn: The NRCS bioengineering supplement was published in 2007, a methodological publication date
The Regge programme began in 1998, not the construction date of the hypothetical bank
Teaching assumption: Scales of bank shear; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; R=0.8 m; S=0.003 dimensionless; tau=rho*g*R*S=23.544 Pa
Teaching assumption: Drag on vegetation stems; rho=1000 kg/m3; Cd=1.1 dimensionless; A=1.2 m2; v=2 m/s; F=0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2=2640 N
Teaching assumption: Effective area in root reinforcement; Tr=1600 N; As=0.2 m2; dc=Tr/As/1000=8 kPa
Teaching assumption: Buoyancy of wood revetments; rhow=1000 kg/m3; rhol=600 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=0.8 m3; Fu=(rhow-rhol)*g*V=3139.2 N
timeline: 1998　雷赫河計畫啟動，作為河川復育尺度參照
2007　NRCS 河岸生物工程方法補編出版
2026　教材來源核對與原創數值重算，屬編修事件而非工程完工
timelineEn: 1998 — The Regge programme begins as a reference for river restoration scale
2007 — NRCS publishes its streambank soil bioengineering technical supplement
2026 — Source verification and original numerical recalculation, a curriculum event rather than project completion
codes: NRCS NEH 654 TS14I 生物工程方法補編，適用性須另查
NRCS 580 國家標準目錄，實作須使用地方適用版
codesEn: NRCS NEH 654 TS14I bioengineering methods, with applicability checked separately
NRCS 580 national directory, requiring the locally applicable version for practice
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：河岸生態護岸
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Bioengineered riverbank protection
guides.concept: 由趾部沖刷、木構浮力到根系補強與季節存活，逐一拆開生態護岸的承載機制。課程要求先辨認河道變遷與植物適生條件，再安排材料、施工窗口與後續監測，以對照組觀察功能是否形成，而不把綠色外觀當成安全證明。
guides.conceptEn: Separate the load paths of toe protection, buoyant wood, root reinforcement and seasonal plant establishment. Identify channel adjustment and vegetation suitability before selecting materials, construction windows and monitoring. Use comparison sites to examine whether the intended functions actually develop instead of treating a green bank as evidence of structural performance.
procedure: 河岸植生先面對水流造成的剪力與局部紊流，再由莖葉、根系及土體共同承受。斷面平均水力半徑乘以能坡只能估算河段平均床面剪力，彎道外岸、橋墩附近與淹沒植物間可能有完全不同的局部荷載。選工法前應把深槽、主流線和沖刷痕跡畫在同一張圖，辨認保護對象是表土、岸趾或整個滑動體，才決定平均量是否足以篩選材料。
植物在水中既增加粗糙度，也把水流動量轉成莖幹與根盤的荷載。迎流面積不是種植面積，而是投影在垂直流向平面的有效面積；柔軟植株彎伏後，面積與阻力係數會隨流速改變。群生植物還會彼此遮蔽或集中水流，因此單株試驗不能簡單乘株數。設計時應區分柔性變形、折斷和連根拔起三條失效路徑，並保留季節葉量不同的工況。
根系穿越潛在剪動面時可提供拉力，但這個貢獻取決於根徑、方向、錨定長度與含水狀態。把根拉力除以土體剪動面積只能得到等效的附加抗剪應力，不能當成整體土壤永久增加的黏聚力。部分根會先滑出或腐朽，另一些根尚未受力，因此同步動員的有效拉力必須由試驗支持。模型應清楚標示剪動面位置，避免把表層密根區的數據套到較深的滑動面。
河岸枯木或根盤可提供粗糙棲地，也可能在洪水中浮起。木材自重與排水體積必須用同一含水狀態比較，部分浸水時不能使用完整體積計算浮力。淨上浮力只是錨定設計的一個分量，水流拖曳、撞擊與繞支點轉動可能控制接頭。木構隨浸泡吸水與腐朽改變密度，因此檢查不能只依新材出廠重量，還需辨認失去土體包覆後的受力路徑。
植生護岸常由岸趾流失開始失去支承，因此埋深應相對於可變河床而非單一施工測點。扣除一次量測沖刷深度能得到幾何餘量，但尚未考慮洪水規模、長期下切與橫向深槽遷移。埋得更深也可能增加施工擾動與地下水交換阻力。合理比較需要把施工基準、自然河床高程與預期變化分開記錄，再以重複測線判斷餘量如何消耗。
生態護岸的功能會隨植物建立而演變，栽植後存活率只是其中一個可重複觀察的指標。萌芽、根系延伸與土壤覆蓋不同步，存活的插穗也可能尚未穿過潛在沖蝕面。調查應追蹤固定植株群並記錄洪水、乾旱與補植，避免把後來新增的植株混入原始分母。比較坡位與物種可找出適生限制，但不能由存活百分比直接推算抗剪強度。
椰纖維毯的採購面積不等於實際覆蓋面積，搭接、端部固定與曲面貼合都會消耗材料。搭接方向要配合水流，避免迎流邊緣掀起後使水在毯下集中。相鄰條帶需保持連續接觸土面，懸空會讓幼根難以穿入，也會形成沖蝕通道。數量估算可以先用平面幾何，但施工驗收還要檢查坡面展長、固定點與排水，不能用足量材料替代安裝品質。
洪水退去後，河道側支承水壓可能先降低，而岸土內水位仍高，產生朝河道的滲流與較低有效應力。植物蒸散不能在短時間內保證消除這種壓差，根系補強也不取代排水條件分析。以水頭差估算孔壓只能描述指定位置與假定連通狀態，真實退水過程還受滲透係數、層理與儲水性控制。監測應把河水位與岸內孔壓時間序列同步對齊。
生態護岸可能攔截細砂，也可能在施工或洪水初期釋出土粒，因此應比較質量通量而非只比較濁度讀數。流量與濃度必須在相同控制體邊界及時段取得，清水側向流入會稀釋濃度卻不代表沉積。輸入減輸出得到的是控制體內暫存與未量側向交換的合計，需要另查床面變化才能歸因。濁度轉濃度關係還會隨粒徑與有機質改變，必須用水樣校準。
工程後植被增加可能來自較濕的年份、放牧減少或上游治理，而不完全由護岸措施造成。前後加對照的設計，用未處理區的同期間變化扣除共同背景，能提供比單純前後比較更清楚的證據。對照區仍須有相近坡位、土壤與管理，並避免受工程水流改變影響。覆蓋率是面積比例，差中之差應以百分點表示；它不能單獨代表物種多樣性、棲地品質或結構安全。
procedureEn: Vegetation encounters flow shear and turbulence before stems, roots and soil share the resulting loads. Hydraulic radius and energy slope give a reach averaged boundary stress, while bends, obstructions and submerged plants can produce very different local loads. Map the thalweg, main current and erosion traces together. Identify whether protection targets surface soil, the toe or an entire sliding mass before deciding whether an average stress can screen a treatment.

Vegetation adds roughness while transferring flow momentum into stems and roots. Frontal area is projected perpendicular to the current, not planted ground area. Flexible plants reconfigure, changing both area and drag coefficient as velocity increases. Neighbouring stems can shelter one another or concentrate flow, so multiplying an isolated plant test by stem count is unreliable. Distinguish bending, stem breakage and root pullout, and retain seasonal changes in foliage as separate loading conditions.

Roots crossing a potential shear surface can mobilize tension, depending on diameter, orientation, anchorage and moisture. Dividing effective root force by soil shear area gives an equivalent stress contribution, not a permanent increase in intrinsic soil cohesion. Some roots pull out or decay before others engage, so simultaneous mobilization requires evidence. Locate the assumed shear surface explicitly, rather than transferring measurements from a shallow dense root layer to a deeper failure plane.

Wood and rootwads create rough habitat but may lift during floods. Compare weight and displaced volume at a consistent moisture state, and use submerged volume for partial immersion. Net uplift is only one anchorage load; drag, impact and rotation about supports may govern connections. Density changes through saturation and decay. Inspection therefore needs the evolving load path after surrounding soil erodes, rather than relying solely on the weight of freshly supplied timber.

Vegetated protection often loses support when its toe erodes. Embedment must therefore reference a changing bed rather than one construction survey point. Subtracting observed scour gives geometric reserve but omits larger floods, long term incision and lateral thalweg migration. Greater embedment can also increase disturbance or obstruct groundwater exchange. Separate construction datum, natural bed elevation and expected change, then use repeated cross sections to track how the reserve is consumed over time.

Bioengineered protection evolves as plants establish, and survival is one repeatable indicator among several. Budding, root extension and soil cover develop at different rates; a living cutting may not yet cross an erosion plane. Track a fixed cohort and record floods, drought and replacements so newly planted individuals do not contaminate the original denominator. Compare species and bank elevations to investigate suitability, without converting survival percentage directly into shear resistance.

Purchased coir mat area differs from effective cover because seams, end anchorage and surface conformity consume material. Orient overlaps with flow so exposed edges do not lift and channel water underneath. Adjacent strips need continuous soil contact; bridging can obstruct root establishment and create erosion pathways. Begin quantities with planar geometry, then inspect slope length, fixings and drainage. Delivering enough material does not demonstrate that the installation transfers loads or supports vegetation as intended.

After a flood, river support pressure may fall before pore pressures inside the bank dissipate, promoting outward seepage and reducing effective stress. Plant transpiration cannot guarantee rapid relief, and roots do not replace drainage analysis. A head difference estimates pressure at a specified point under assumed connectivity, while actual drawdown depends on permeability, layering and storage. Synchronize river stage and internal piezometer records to distinguish transient pressure lag from static groundwater conditions.

A treatment may trap fines or release soil during construction and early floods. Compare mass flux rather than turbidity alone, matching discharge and concentration at the same boundaries and times. Clear lateral inflow can dilute concentration without depositing sediment. Inflow minus outflow represents storage plus unmeasured exchanges, requiring bed observations before attribution. The turbidity to concentration relation also changes with grain size and organic material, so physical samples are needed for calibration.

Vegetation can increase because a year is wetter, grazing declines or upstream management changes. A before-after comparison with an untreated reach subtracts shared background change and offers stronger evidence than a simple before-after count. The comparison reach still needs similar soils, elevation and management, without receiving the treatment's hydraulic effects. Cover is an area proportion, so the difference in differences uses percentage points and does not independently measure biodiversity, habitat quality or structural safety.
evidence: 改以能坡增加一半重算平均剪力，再繪製兩個具有相同平均值但主流位置不同的斷面，說明哪一種情況需要增加岸趾量測，並列出判讀依據。
將流速增加百分之二十五並保持面積不變重算，再提出一個彎伏後面積縮小的對照案例，說明為何兩者的阻力增幅不同，以及所需影像資料。
將有效拉力降低四分之一重算，並畫出穿根與不穿根的兩個滑面。為每個滑面列出必須取得的試驗資料，說明等效應力何時應取零。
比較木材密度增加到八百公斤每立方公尺後的淨浮力，另畫一個岸趾淘空的偏心支承圖，指出還缺哪些尺寸才能計算錨點受力。
假設第二次事件再降低河床三十公分，更新幾何餘量並說明為何仍無法宣布安全。規劃兩條新增測線以捕捉深槽側移，標出與舊基準的連結。
evidenceEn: Increase energy slope by half and recompute average shear. Sketch two sections with equal averages but different current positions, then explain which requires additional toe measurements and what observations would justify that decision.

Increase velocity by twenty five percent at fixed area, then construct a comparison with reduced area after bending. Explain the different force changes and identify the imagery needed to distinguish these cases.

Reduce effective tension by one quarter and recalculate. Draw failure planes crossing and bypassing roots, list the necessary evidence for each, and explain when the equivalent root contribution must be set to zero.

Recalculate uplift for timber density of eight hundred kilograms per cubic metre. Draw an eccentric support after toe erosion and identify the additional dimensions needed to resolve anchor forces and moments.

Lower the bed another thirty centimetres and update the reserve without declaring stability. Place two additional transects to detect lateral thalweg migration and show how they connect to the original survey datum.
pitfalls: 彎道近岸高速帶可能掏空根區，使表面完整的植生毯失去支承。診斷須追查水下岸趾與局部流向，而非先把植株死亡判成養護不足。
若實際滑動面位於根層下方，即使表層根系茂密也可能整塊滑落。應先查滑面深度與排水條件，而不是繼續增加表層播種密度。
若深槽移到護岸外緣，先前測線可能漏掉局部淘空。表面仍貼合的護岸不代表底部有支承，需用水下測量確認邊界是否改變。
材料總面積足夠但接縫逆流或鬆弛時，水會掀毯並從下方沖走細土。裸露小縫可能擴大成集中溝，應追查接縫方向及固定點。
若下游被清水稀釋，濃度下降可能被誤報成攔砂成功。漏算側向流量或採樣時間錯開，也會製造假質量差，應先閉合水量帳。
pitfallsEn: A near-bank jet can undermine roots while the surface mat still appears intact. Investigate the submerged toe and current direction before attributing plant loss to poor maintenance alone.
A slide beneath the root zone can remove a densely vegetated surface as one block. Investigate slip depth and drainage before prescribing more seed or greater surface planting density.

A migrating thalweg may create local undermining between previous transects. An apparently flush surface does not prove support underneath; underwater surveys must check whether the erosion boundary has shifted.

Adequate total material can still fail when loose or upstream-facing seams lift. Water then removes soil beneath the mat, turning small openings into channels; inspect seam orientation and fixing locations.

Dilution can make lower concentration appear to prove trapping. Missing lateral flows or mismatched sampling times also create false mass differences, so close the water balance before interpreting sediment retention.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 河床固床工設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「河岸剪力的尺度」與「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；河床固床工設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Scales of bank shear" and "Mat overlap and effective coverage" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Riverbed grade-control structures must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以水流荷載、活體建立與河岸監測共同設計護岸；河床固床工設計則以由河床縱坡、能量耗散與泥砂連續性設計固床工為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on designing bank protection through hydraulic loads, plant establishment and monitoring; Riverbed grade-control structures centres on designing grade control through bed slope, energy dissipation and sediment continuity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「河岸剪力的尺度」與「落差配置與縱坡」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到河床固床工設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「濾層粒徑的相容比較」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Scales of bank shear” and “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Riverbed grade-control structures, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Filter grading compatibility", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 河岸生態護岸
history.text: 美國自然資源保育署二〇〇七年河岸土壤生物工程補編，將河趾、岸坡與洪氾平原的處理方式分開討論，並收錄佛蒙特州威努斯基河背景。二〇二〇年國家層級護岸標準目錄另提醒實作須依地方文件。雷赫河一九九八年啟動的復育計畫則提供河川動態與棲地共存的尺度參照。本課不聲稱這些案例採用相同工法，所有荷載及材料數字均為獨立教材假設。
history.textEn: The 2007 NRCS soil bioengineering supplement distinguishes treatments at the toe, bank and floodplain and includes Winooski River context in Vermont. The 2020 national bank protection directory directs actual application to local documents. The Regge programme launched in 1998 offers a broader example of accommodating river dynamics and habitat. These references do not imply identical construction methods. All loads and material quantities in the exercises are independently chosen teaching assumptions.
